messages:
Leo (AE): Prospect wants BYO-HSM POC: monthly rotation, attestation artifacts, and a clause that Redwood never has access to unwrapped KEKs. Asking for feasibility + example pricing.
Mina (Solutions): Feasible. Two main options: proxy to their KMS or customer-wrapped DEKs. Proxy = live forwarding (no KEK kept), envelope = customer uploads wrapped keys.
Jules (SE): They require split-custody for ceremonies and timestamped attestation PDF monthly. We'll need a small attestation metadata schema.
Ravi (Crypto): Acceptable attestation: vendor-signed attestation blob, SHA256 fingerprint, HSM serial, and timestamp. For split-custody, accept N-of-M signatures; customer must supply aggregation. Rotation: we can trigger via customer rotate API (proxy) or swap to pre-wrapped_dek_vN (envelope).
Nora (Legal): We can add a "no long-term access" clause and a liability carve-out for lost KEKs. Need SOW language: definition of terms, attestation acceptance criteria, retention obligations (hashes vs blobs), and agreed emergency rekey runbook for 48h rollback.
Leo (AE): Pricing ask: ballpark for 100k tokens/day?
Mina (Solutions): Ballpark: envelope + integration = +7-12% uplift over Dedicated commit; proxy with HA tunnels + egress = +30-40%. Precise quote needs throughput profile and rotation cadence.
deploy-bot: Provisioned staging proxy tunnels in us-east-1; latency probe scheduled.
Jules (SE): I'll draft the attestation metadata schema: signer_id, signature_b64, hsm_model, report_sha256, timestamp, ceremony_id.
Ravi (Crypto): I'll prepare a rotation runbook (cutover steps, drain windows, attestation capture).
Nora (Legal): Drafting SOW clauses and retention language; will post for review.
Leo (AE): Next steps: 1) Mina to prepare cost worksheet + two diagrams (proxy vs envelope) 2) Jules/Ravi to produce schema + runbook 3) Nora to draft SOW. I'll share with customer once ready.
Mina (Solutions): On it, will deliver EOD.
